strategies.native-code: source/code-family + native code, plus nontrivial exit status; no lookup of a predefined error catalog
strategies.exception-type: qualified capitalized names ending in Error or Exception in report syntax (coarse)
strategies.message-template: explicit diagnostic/failure lines normalized for paths, quoted arguments and locations

session_overlap: deduplicate expanded segments by original event index/part/channel
excluded: tool call arguments as error evidence
output_missing_policy: report missing payload; never infer a tool error from its metadata
semantic_limits: same error does not prove same root cause
text mention is not observed failure
no fix or Skill is inferred
